description: This file defines the PathChangedHelper class, which provides helper functions for handling route path changes in Drupal. It manages URL objects for old and new paths, constructs redirects, and offers methods to retrieve paths and perform redirects.

classes.name: PathChangedHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing route path changes, providing methods to get old/new paths and perform redirects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the helper with route and request data, creating URL objects for old and new paths.

methods.name: oldPath
methods.description: Returns the internal path of the deprecated (old) URL.

methods.name: newPath
methods.description: Returns the internal path of the updated (new) URL.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Returns a RedirectResponse object to redirect to the new URL with a 301 status.
